title: Fix customer ordering ban-check failure and allow any admin to delegate admin access

requirements.text: Fix the customer order flow so authenticated, non-banned users can create orders without failing due to a ban-status pre-check (current error: cannot check if they are banned).

quotes: It’s not working for customers to order it says it can’t check if there banned fix it make sure everything works for everyone

acceptanceCriteria: From a signed-in (Internet Identity) account that is not banned, submitting the New Order form successfully creates an order and shows the success confirmation UI.
If the UI performs a ban check before order creation, that ban check does not fail due to missing backend method or authorization errors.
If the caller is banned, order creation is blocked and the user sees a clear English error message indicating they are banned.

requirements.text: Add/adjust backend ban-check APIs so the frontend can reliably determine ban status for the currently authenticated caller without requiring admin permissions (e.g., a query like isCallerBanned()), and ensure order creation still enforces the ban server-side.

quotes: it says it can’t check if there banned

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that lets an authenticated user check their own ban status without trapping for authorization reasons.
Order creation endpoints continue to enforce ban status on the backend (banned users cannot create orders even if the frontend skips the pre-check).
The frontend ban-check call used during order creation aligns with the backend method signature and does not produce runtime errors.

requirements.text: Update backend authorization for admin delegation so any authenticated admin (not just the owner) can grant admin access to another user by email via the existing admin-access API used by the UI.

quotes: make sure ... any admin can give admin access not just owner

acceptanceCriteria: A caller who is an admin can successfully grant admin access using the backend method invoked by the frontend (grantAdminAccess(email)).
A non-admin caller cannot grant admin access and receives an English unauthorized error.
Granting admin access is recorded in the audit log with the granting admin principal and the target email/principal details.

requirements.text: Update backend authorization for admin delegation so any authenticated admin (not just the owner) can revoke admin access by email via the existing admin-access API used by the UI, while preventing removal of the owner’s admin access.

quotes: any admin can give admin access not just owner

acceptanceCriteria: A caller who is an admin can successfully revoke admin access using the backend method invoked by the frontend (revokeAdminAccess(email)).
The backend prevents revoking admin access for the configured owner email (OWNER_EMAIL) even if attempted directly, returning an English error.
A non-admin caller cannot revoke admin access and receives an English unauthorized error.
Revoking admin access is recorded in the audit log with the revoking admin principal and the target email/principal details.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if state schema changes require it.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or off-chain storage.
